description: First verification launcher used /opt/pyvenv/bin/python. An unrelated spreadsheet-runtime startup hook spawned an orphan RPC daemon (~1.39 GB RSS), causing memory pressure in a 4 GiB cgroup. The outer next batch timed out at 35 seconds; only two compiler version commands had recorded exits. No PASS was emitted.
cleanup: Terminated the orphan daemon and in-progress compiler/Lake children. Preserved incomplete verification directory. Fresh run uses /usr/bin/python3 and clears project build cache again.
